judgments.reason: The model never articulated that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that this allows bids exceeding available coins to win. The transcript shows normal payment then commission; no mechanism describing inclusion-before-payment is given.

The model did not articulate that waiting reveals sealed rival bid VALUES before the focal player commits. The transcript and trace show commitments resolve when all have committed and no description of an information leak from waiting is provided.

The model's statements describe closing after all lots are resolved; it did not identify or demonstrate early settlement occurring with unauctioned lots. The observed close happened after all lots were resolved, so no discrepancy was articulated.

The model never claimed that the three-coin auction commission applies to catalog purchases, nor did it show any observed case of commission being given for a buy action. No mechanism of objective substitution was articulated or demonstrated.
